items.quote: Collin was incredibly professional and extremely talented! Brought our beautiful dream to life! Would recommend him for any project you may have on your to-do list!

Collin of The Heights Handyman first installed fascia and soffit in our garage. The quality of work was excellent, the price was great. Collin worked diligently and performed the work we needed within the timeframe we discussed.

Colin was easy to work with and the workmanship is second to none. I had several guys come by and either never sent an estimate or they were impossible to track down a schedule. Colin and his helper really delivered.
